stories.title: Itália limita a 30% número de alunos sem fluência em italiano por sala e proíbe burcas em escolas

en.title: Italy limits students without Italian fluency to 30% per classroom and bans burqas in schools
en.summary: Italy's government approved a decree establishing a maximum of 30% of students per classroom with limited Italian language proficiency and prohibiting face-covering Islamic veils in schools. The conservative administration states the measures aim to strengthen integration through language learning.

stories.title: O que caixa-preta de helicóptero pode dizer sobre queda que resultou na morte do cantor Rick e mais 4

en.title: What helicopter's black box can reveal about crash that killed singer Rick and 4 others
en.summary: A helicopter crashed in Santa Catarina state, killing five people including singer Rick. The aircraft's black box, which records cockpit sounds, will help investigators reconstruct events leading to the crash that occurred in a forested area.

stories.title: Conselho do MPF decide nesta sexta se abre investigação sobre atuação de Gonet no caso Master

en.title: Federal Public Ministry council decides Friday whether to open investigation into Gonet's actions in Master case
en.summary: Brazil's Federal Public Ministry council will decide whether to investigate Prosecutor-General Paulo Gonet over allegations connected to the Master banking case. The inquiry examines Gonet's conduct in investigating the bank, arresting banker Daniel Vorcaro, and handling related investigations.

stories.title: José Sarney é internado em SP para dar continuidade a tratamento de pneumonia

en.title: Former president José Sarney hospitalized in São Paulo to continue pneumonia treatment
en.summary: Former Brazilian president José Sarney, 96, was hospitalized in São Paulo to continue treatment for pneumonia. Hospital officials report his clinical condition is stable.

stories.title: Governo Meloni aprova lei que limita a 30% número de alunos em salas de aula que não falam italiano

en.title: Meloni Government Approves Law Limiting Non-Italian Speaking Students to 30% in Classrooms
en.summary: Italy's government approved a decree restricting the proportion of foreign students who do not speak Italian in school classes to 30% and banned face-covering accessories like Islamic veils in schools, with fines up to €1,000.

stories.title: Renner fala pela primeira vez após morte de Rick: 'O show não pode parar'

en.title: Renner Speaks for the First Time Following Rick's Death: 'The Show Must Go On'
en.summary: Renner from the musical duo Rick and Renner made his first public statement following Rick's death, releasing a video expressing gratitude for fan support during the difficult period after the accident.

stories.title: Governo endurece regras para fundos para tentar frear casos como Master e Carbono Oculto

en.title: Government Tightens Rules for Funds in Attempt to Prevent Cases Like Master and Carbono Oculto
en.summary: The government strengthened regulations for investment funds in response to high-profile fund-related controversies.

stories.title: Governo endurece regras dos Fidcs e tenta frear casos como Carbono Oculto e Banco Master

en.title: Government Tightens Rules for Fidcs and Attempts to Prevent Cases Like Carbono Oculto and Banco Master
en.summary: The National Monetary Council approved stricter oversight of credit rights investment funds and prohibited the purchase of rights linked to ongoing lawsuits and arbitrations without final rulings.

stories.title: Caso Master lança suspeita sobre origem de precatórios

en.title: Master case raises suspicion about origin of precatories
en.summary: Investigation into fraud at Banco Master suggests one branch of Daniel Vorcaro's gang may have involved bribing judges to gain advantages in the precatories market, which deals with public sector debts arbitrated by the judiciary.

stories.title: Após pneumonia, Sarney vai a São Paulo para realizar exames

en.title: After pneumonia, Sarney goes to São Paulo for exams
en.summary: The former president travels to São Paulo to undergo medical examinations as part of his recovery from pneumonia.

stories.title: Renner fala sobre morte de Rick em vídeo: ‘Aos poucos a gente vai levantar’

en.title: Renner speaks about Rick's death in video: 'Little by little we will rise'
en.summary: Renner addresses the death of Rick through a video message expressing hope for recovery.

stories.title: Sarney está internado em SP para tratar pneumonia, diz boletim

en.title: Sarney is hospitalized in SP to treat pneumonia, says bulletin
en.summary: Former president José Sarney, 96, remains hospitalized in stable condition at Hospital Sírio-Libanês in São Paulo receiving treatment for bacterial pneumonia under the care of cardiologist Roberto Kalil Filho.

stories.title: Mensagens encontradas pela PF indicam proximidade entre Alcolumbre e Vorcaro, diz revista

en.title: Messages found by Federal Police indicate proximity between Alcolumbre and Vorcaro, says magazine
en.summary: Messages discovered on former banker Daniel Vorcaro's phone by Federal Police show a close relationship between the former Master Bank owner and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. The senator uses affectionate language toward Vorcaro in their conversations and congratulates him on the Senate presidency election.

stories.title: Aneel não teve segurança quanto a benefícios apresentados pela Eneva para validar acordo sobre térmicas, diz diretor-geral

en.title: Aneel lacked certainty about benefits presented by Eneva to validate thermal plants agreement, says director-general
en.summary: The director-general of Brazil's National Electric Energy Agency stated the regulator did not approve an agreement concerning thermoelectric plants contract flexibility because it lacked confidence in all presented benefits. The proposed arrangement was under discussion with the federal government and Court of Accounts.

stories.title: ONS: Leilão de baterias pode reduzir cortes de renováveis em até 50%, diz diretor-geral

en.title: ONS: Battery auction can reduce renewable generation cuts by up to 50%, says director-general
en.summary: Brazil's electricity system operator estimates a battery auction scheduled for December could reduce renewable energy curtailment by 40 to 50 percent. The actual percentage will depend on the size of the contracts awarded through the auction.

stories.title: Lula reforça que vai 'acabar' com bets e promete medidas sobre crédito

en.title: Lula reiterates he will 'end' betting and promises credit measures
en.summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva reiterated his intention to eliminate online betting in Brazil and announced forthcoming policy measures. He expressed concern about Brazilian household debt and credit card usage during a rally in Alagoas.

stories.title: Abertura do mercado de energia vai acelerar atualização da estrutura tarifária, diz CEO da Light

en.title: Energy market opening will accelerate tariff structure update, says Light CEO
en.summary: Light's CEO states that allowing consumers to choose electricity suppliers from late 2028 will speed up discussions on tariff structure reform. The company is testing regulatory approaches to offer prices better aligned with consumer behavior.
